profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience on infrastructure development using C/C++ on Linux. With hands on OOP analysis and design, data structures, TCP/IP sockets, threads, IPC, profiling and reverse engineering tools.

Enjoy mentoring team members; Able to understand the broader system, and subdivide a complex task during the design phase into granulated pieces; write technical documents. Good analytical and mathematical skills. Self-learner.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working in the Microsoft CTO office, Technology and Research group, where we are conceptualizing and building a new generation system.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer at Dell Technologies
Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer– FirePower Next Generation Firewall     (Aug 2015 – current)
- Mentored new development team to get up to speed on FirePower system, including dev environment, bug fixing and Customer case troubleshooting.
- Contributed on new identity propagation library, using C/C++, RabbitMQ, boost, multi-threading, OOP, MySQL, ZeroMQ, Google protobuf, valgrind, gdb, reverse engineering and Static Analysis.
- Led new feature development from concept to final product release, to integrate virtualized (VMWare EXSi and XEN hypervisors) shared environments (Citrix XenApp and XenDesktop) with FirePower systems, involving OS: Windows Server, Windriver Linux, SFOS Linux; languages: C/C++, C#, Java, Perl; cloud: REST, Json; low level: Windows Filter Network Kernel Driver, Driver Certification; protocols: HTTPS, LDAP, DNS, TCP/IP; tools: GNU chain, GDB, Wireshark, Postman; repo: P4, CVS, GIT; libraries: ZeroMQ, Google protobuf, gtest, boost.
- Contributed on captive portal identity feature, by designing and developing a new apache module (https, apache, C/C++, TCP/IP, IPC, multi-threading, boost, google protobuf, gtest, wireshark, LDAP).
- Provided advanced training to TAC and Development to assist on Escalation cases.
- Provided support to Escalations and QA teams on defects driving from root cause to resolution.

Software Engineer– ASA - CX Next Generation Firewall        (Jan 2013 – July 2015)
- Contributed on different security features such as Telemetry (C++, ZeroMQ), Updater (Python), User identity (C/C++, LDAP, DNS), Inspection Engine (C/C++) and Library packaging (Python, Bitbake/OpenEmbedded/YOCTO), Support tunnel (Python) on a Montavista OS firewall.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer C++ (Jun 12 - Nov 13)
Working offshore for SONY, helping to design and develop a C++ test suite from scratch for proprietary TCP framework, using CppUnit, Gcov and Lcov for Linux and Windows (Visual Studio 2010).

Senior Software Engineer C++ (Jan 12 - May 12)
Maintaining and enhancing Augmented Reality videogame using C++, OGRE, ARToolKit, Direct3D9  and Visual Studio 2010.

Technical Lead in C++ (Oct 11 - Dec 11)
Worked on-site at BioWare’s office as the access point for Argentina’s development team. Helped to deliver, test, install and deploy infraestructure Crash report middleware.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.locationName: Monterrey Area, Mexico and San Mateo, CA
positions.description:
Software Architect (Mar 09 - Sep 11)
Worked as offshore Platform developer at SugarSync Inc, using C++ and Java, for Internet-scale client-server development, in cross-platform, particularly Linux, Windows and Mac OS. Object-oriented analysis and design, TCP/IP and sockets, threads and concurrent, software architecture and database concepts (MySQL).

Senior Software Engineer (Sep 07 - Feb 09)
Developed a mobile car system able to watch Satellite TV, get road assistance, load and play digital entertainment audio, video and pictures, navigate with GPS guidance and real-time route calculation and route voice assistance. The system was built using MS Visual C++ .NET 2003 and 2005, ActiveX, VLC, QuickTime and a third party SDK for Mobile TV Guide using MS Visual C++.NET 2005 and C.

positions.title: Technical Leader
positions.description: Worked as Technical Leader on an Enterprise Resource Planning solution. Developed Inventory, Warehouse, Stock Lines and Point of Sales modules for a huge ERP using MS C# windows Forms .NET 2003 and 2005 storing data into PostgreSQL database.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed HMI for Steel Melting Plants, using  MS Visual C++ .NET 2003 and MS C# windows Forms .NET 2003.

positions.title: Research Assistant, Electronic and Communication Center
positions.description: Was part of the team on charge of researching wireless technology for smart antennas and Ad-Hoc networks for CDMA 3G, using Matlab for simulations and C for algorithms.
